status: Ideal simulated baseline; hardware part numbers, noise, sample rates and calibration remain unselected.

camera.name: head_camera
camera.mount: Fixed snout; lens ahead of head envelopes; no pan/tilt actuator.
camera.limitations: Pinhole optics only. No depth, stereo, distortion, exposure, rolling shutter or latency model. Geometry is a packaging allowance, not a selected camera's CAD.

imu.orientation: Aligned with pelvis axes, rigidly mounted inside core
imu.accelerometer_units: m/s^2 of specific force in IMU frame; about +9.81 on upright stationary Z, zero in free fall
imu.limitations: Ideal readings; no bias, noise, drift, mounting compliance or timing model. No magnetometer. Orientation requires an estimator on hardware.

joint_feedback.order: Actuator order, exported with joint_names by sensors.onboard_readings
joint_feedback.limitations: Velocity may require differentiating bus position feedback. Encoder resolution, bus rate and latency need identification.

foot_contact.units: N; sum of contact normal forces on the matching foot body inside its touch volume
foot_contact.mass_accounting: Any added physical pad, ADC and wiring must fit the current foot/core budgets or be added to model mass.
foot_contact.limitations: Ideal MuJoCo touch sensors; not a selected FSR or load-cell design. They do not measure shear force or provide a hardware center of pressure.

onboard_adapter: sensors.onboard_readings excludes simulator-only state and foot forces by default; camera pixels are rendered separately.
tail: Robot tail is rigid and unmotorized; no tail sensor or actuator required.
